title: Story pack: which year-end deck is yours?
hook: There are two kinds of year-end marketing deck. Which one is on your screen?
caption:
Story pack (no feed caption).

A this-or-that for the last working week of the year. Frame 2 sets the two decks side by side. Frame 3 is the poll. Frame 4 gives the one slide worth adding.
alt_text: Five vertical story frames. Frame 1: The year-end deck, which one is yours? Frame 2 compares Deck A (spend by month, ROAS by month, top ten ads, thank you) with Deck B (what we tested, what we learnt, what we stop doing, what we test first). Frame 3 is a poll asking which deck is on your screen. Frame 4 suggests adding a slide called three things our ads taught us. Frame 5: every ad should make the next one better.
cta: Vote in the poll; share with whoever is building the deck
